review.notes: Full review (418 changed lines since 1e85c71). Of r96's findings, R02, R05, R07 and R08 are repaired and R06 is repaired but one Check short; R03 and R04 are partly repaired; R01, R09 and R10 are not. The gate fails (outside-folder=2, the same two one-line hunks). Depcheck: 235 roadmaps, 2258 edges, 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates (exit 0, 14 sorry warnings only); a #check @ pass over 26 declarations is consistent; a one-tactic padding probe fails on all 14 theorems. A scratch import probe shows that the companion files' identifiers (puncturedPair, twistedRelativeHomology, coordinateSimplexPair, fullSimplex) are gone, so lake build fails (P1). New: Stage 5.0/5.5 restate the pinned exhaustive-filtration convergence and the filtered-space spectral sequence (P2); a DG2.4 citation names a section without the outward-first S2 orientation (P3); the finite-CW-type headlines have no locator (P3); one definition has only two Checks (P3). Sample of 15 locators read in the cache (Strickland 1.6, 1.7, 1.9, 1.10, 2.6; KMR Thm A; Goerss-Schemmerhorn Ex 2.15, Thm 4.1; Hatcher 3.2 Ex 2, 3.30, 4.8, 4.30, 4.31, 4.33, 4.35, 4.37, 4.57, A.12); 25 adversarial rows with computed values, including the eta_n sign chain and the ofCube orientation.
